Stop comparing coefficients. | Every JEE student wastes | a minute on this.
Use the cover-up trick. | Want A? Cover x minus 1, | put x equals 1.
Top: minus 2. Bottom: minus 2. | A is 1.
Want B? Cover x plus 1, | put x equals minus 1. | 12 over 6. B is 2.
Now you try C. | Cover x minus 2, | put x equals 2.
Minus 3 over 3. C is minus 1. | No equations at all.
